notes.title: BETA version will be published this month!!
notes.notes:
[p]The first [b]BETA version of [i]The Simple Balance[/i][/b] will be available later this month!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42006725/d5b77e0edb7412cdf2fc383d6aae05e9865bb8cf.png"][/img]
It's a first beta version of the game — but it's fully playable, and we’re excited to finally share it with you.
Your feedback is more than welcome and will help shape the future of the game![/p][p]This version only supports 16:9 resolutions!!! [/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
